body_es: Las métricas de flujo permiten al equipo cuantificar la eficiencia de su proceso de entrega: Lead Time es el tiempo desde que se solicita una característica hasta que se entrega en producción; Cycle Time es el tiempo desde el inicio del trabajo hasta la finalización; Throughput es la cantidad de trabajo completado en un período específico. Otras métricas clave incluyen Work in Progress (WIP) acumulado y la distribución del tiempo entre tareas. Al monitorear estas métricas, los equipos pueden identificar cuellos de botella, detectar tendencias de mejora y demostrar valor entregado a los stakeholders.
body_en: Flow metrics allow teams to quantify delivery process efficiency: Lead Time is the time from feature request to production delivery; Cycle Time is the time from work start to completion; Throughput is the amount of work completed in a specific period. Other key metrics include accumulated Work in Progress (WIP) and time distribution across tasks. By monitoring these metrics, teams can identify bottlenecks, detect improvement trends, and demonstrate value delivered to stakeholders.
example_code:
# Flow Metrics (YAML)
flow_metrics:
  lead_time:
    definition: "Request to delivery in production"
    unit: "days"
    current_value: 7
    target: 3
    how_to_improve: "Reduce handoffs, parallelize work"
  
  cycle_time:
    definition: "Work start to completion"
    unit: "days"
    current_value: 4
    target: 2
    how_to_improve: "Reduce waiting time, increase focus"
  
  throughput:
    definition: "Items completed per week"
    unit: "items/week"
    current_value: 8
    trend: "Increasing"
    target: 12
    how_to_improve: "Reduce cycle time, maintain quality"
  
  wip_accumulation:
    definition: "Average work in progress at any time"
    unit: "items"
    current_value: 6
    target: 5
    how_to_improve: "Enforce WIP limits more strictly"
  
  velocity:
    definition: "Story points completed per sprint"
    unit: "points/sprint"
    current_value: 34
    trend: "Stable"
    use: "Sprint planning and forecasting"

  tracking:
    tool: "Kanban board with time tracking"
    frequency: "Updated daily"
    review: "Weekly team metrics review"
example_output:
